events.title: After 13 years as goalkeeper for 아스널, David Seaman joins 맨체스터 시티 on a free transfer, signing a one-year contract.
맨체스터 유나이티드 sells English football star 데이비드 베컴 to 레알 마드리드 for €35 million.
데이비드 베컴 agrees to join 레알 마드리드 in a £25 million deal after 12 years at 맨체스터 유나이티드.
레알 마드리드 clinches the Primera división , the top football league in Spain, beating 레알 소시에다드 by two points. The very next day, 레알 마드리드 fires its manager, Vicente del Bosque .

Marc-Vivien Foé , who scored 9 goals in 35 games on loan at 맨체스터 시티 —and had previously had a spell with 웨스트햄 유나이티드 between 1999 and 2000—collapsed and died during a FIFA Confederations Cup tie for Cameroon .

Cameroonian soccer player Marc-Vivien Foé collapsed during a Confederations Cup semi-final between Cameroon and Colombia in Lyon , France. He subsequently died after doctors failed to resuscitate him. He played for 리옹 and was loaned to 맨체스터 시티 F.C. in the 2002/03 season.
Marc-Vivien Foé , who spent the 2002–03 season on loan to 맨체스터 시티 , collapses and dies at the age of 28 during a Confederations Cup tie for Cameroon .
Italy 's Piedmont wins the third UEFA Regions' Cup , beating France's Maine 2–1 in 하이덴하임 an der Brenz .
